verdict.rationale: Zulip documents its own bot framework that reacts to messages. Users can write and run custom or existing bots, deployable via the Zulip Botserver, which gives event-driven automated actions. However, this is code-based bot authoring rather than a rules engine, and it only covers message events. Zapier/IFTTT are third-party tools and incoming webhooks are inbound only, so neither counts. Missing for 10: a no-code rule/trigger definition UI, documented event types beyond messages, a conditions/actions model, and independent hands-on corroboration.
